subject: Archaeology
title: Virtual Reality Archaeology
description: Learn Virtual Reality Archaeology in one minute.

hook.text: You can walk through ancient Rome in a VR headset, built entirely from real dig data.

buildup.text: Archaeologists combine excavation data, 3D scans, and evidence to build virtual worlds.

discovery.text: Rome Reborn is a digital model of the entire city in 320 CE, based on real evidence.

twist.text: VR lets researchers test theories. Does this temple align with the solstice? Walk and see.

climax.text: Destroyed sites like Palmyra survive as digital twins. The model endures after the ruin.

punchline.text: The building was destroyed. Its digital twin lives on forever.

quiz.question: How does VR help archaeological research beyond visualization?
options: It allows time travel to observe events as they happened
Researchers test theories like temple alignments by walking through models
